title: TapConvert
description: Helps people hit exact upload limits on forms and chats by compressing photos, video, and PDFs on-device, with zero server uploads.
details: Built with Kotlin and a 10-module clean architecture. Uses hardware-accelerated Media3 and in-memory FFmpeg pipelines to compress images, audio, and video on-device without cloud dependencies or privacy risks. Fully covered by zero-mock contract unit tests.

images.caption: TapConvert dashboard with 1-tap conversion presets and modern Material You UI.
System share sheet integration for instant conversions directly from any app.
Granular compression settings and target file size constraints.
Hardware-accelerated on-device transcoding with zero battery waste.
Instant storage savings verification and clean export sharing.

title: JsonExport
description: Turns messy nested JSON into clean Excel and CSV files without sending sensitive data to any server.
details: Client-side Next.js tool engineered for high throughput. Parses 100MB+ datasets in the browser with Monaco Editor integration, recursive data flattening, and instant exports (CSV, Excel, HTML, ZIP).

images.caption: JsonExport banner showcasing the primary value proposition.
Export panel showing options for CSV, Excel, HTML, and ZIP downloads.
Data grid visualizing the parsed and flattened JSON structure.

title: VideoMascot
description: Automates mascot and explainer video production, including lip-synced speech, without writing frame files to disk.
details: Modular puppet and mascot animation engine designed for automated media pipelines. Renders Preston Blair 9-viseme speech lip-sync from audio timestamps with inverse kinematics and streams directly to FFmpeg memory buffers without writing intermediate frames to disk.

images.caption: In-memory video streaming overlay demo: 9-viseme speech lip-sync and pointer stick gesturing over background video.
Preston Blair standard 9-viseme phonetic speech lip-sync set mapped to audio timestamps.
Kinematic gesture solving: Pointing up-right with modular prop using analytical 2-joint kinematics.

title: Universal Undo
description: The Ctrl+Z your Android never had. Shake to undo deleted text across any app. 100% offline in under 3MB RAM.
details: System-wide undo service leveraging Android Accessibility APIs. Retains transient keystroke history locally in RAM with zero cloud permissions, zero telemetry, and instant gesture restoration.
metrics: Live on Google Play with in-app purchases

images.caption: Live service status and quick controls at a glance.
Trigger mode, history limits, and notification settings.
Simple onboarding guide for enabling and using undo.

title: AltPadi
description: Chrome extension helping Nigerian shoppers compare lower-cost alternatives on Jumia by analyzing price, specs, and rating signals.
details: Lightweight, zero-backend Chrome MV3 extension. Modular marketplace parser isolated behind domain adapters for testability and future retailer expansion. Fully tested with Vitest.

title: Nigerian TTS
description: Gives creators authentic Nigerian-accent voiceovers on demand, with unlimited generation and no watermarks.
details: Test-driven TTS engine built with Python. Features smart clause/sentence text chunking, CLI/API interfaces, and health-checked proxy management. Backed by 168 automated tests achieving 85%+ code coverage.

title: ListingHarvester
description: Collects listings from multiple sites on autopilot, with crash recovery and clean exports when long runs get interrupted.
details: Modular Python data extraction framework featuring rate limiting, deduplication, JSON/CSV/SQLite export, and crash recovery checkpoints for long-running harvest jobs.

images.caption: Interactive scraping run with progress tracking and rate-limited requests.
Structured multi-format export verified with automated parser tests.

title: MediTrace Health
description: Hospital management platform built for security research, with documented attack paths and defensive fixes for OWASP Top 10 training.
details: Full-stack healthcare management application built with FastAPI and React. Implements clinical workflows alongside documented vulnerability vectors (SQLi, IDOR, XSS, SSRF) for defensive mitigation training.

images.caption: MediTrace Health clinical dashboard and OWASP Top 10 security testing sandbox.

title: 49Blox — Digital Music Collectibles
description: Full-stack platform enabling fans to own fractional music rights with real-time orderbooks and secondary trading.
details: High-performance digital collectibles platform with live pricing graphs, portfolio analytics, and secure Node.js transactional APIs.

images.caption: Platform dashboard displaying digital music collectibles and ownership stakes.
Primary orderbook and pricing graph for a tokenized song.
Secondary marketplace view where users can trade their music asset shares.

title: Coddle
description: Wordle for developers — guess the programming term with color-coded feedback and streak statistics.
details: Interactive Vue-based puzzle game with animated tile reveals, win/loss stats, streak tracking, and shareable results.

images.caption: The initial state of the Coddle game board showing empty tiles ready for user input.
Gameplay view demonstrating color-coded feedback when an incorrect guess is submitted.
Victory modal displaying user statistics, streak, and a shareable summary.

title: Dainty Proofreader
description: A commercial writing product that polishes grammar, tone, and clarity in real time, with accounts and billing built in.
details: Full-stack AI writing SaaS with streaming LLM integration, live diff rendering, secure auth, and subscription billing. Deployed to production.

images.caption: Dainty Proofreader interface icon.

title: This Portfolio
description: Purpose-built portfolio delivering sub-second load times, WebP image pipelines, and modular vanilla architecture without heavy framework bloat.
details: Engineered with modern Vite, pure vanilla JavaScript, automated Sharp WebP compression, and unit test coverage with Vitest.

images.caption: Responsive multi-device layout visualization.
Portfolio live desktop view.

title: FreeTrialFinder
description: Watches AI API credits, free trials, and promo codes across providers, and alerts before money is left on the table.
details: Modular, test-driven cost monitor covering Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, and Bedrock for IDEs like Cursor and Cline. Scheduled scans with Telegram alerts.

title: ImageGenPiper
description: Produces product and marketing images in bulk through an automated pipeline, instead of one manual prompt at a time.
details: Python CLI plus Chrome MV3 extension bridge for bulk Gemini web image generation. Async pipeline with full-resolution downloads and no API rate limits.

title: MotionPicturesToolkit
description: Turns product info into finished marketing videos automatically, cutting out repetitive editing work.
details: Modular, programmatic motion graphics and automated product video generation pipeline for web and mobile. Monorepo with reusable packages.

title: Researcher Train
description: Turns raw web input into structured, validated research output through a staged pipeline with checks at every step.
details: Multi-stage research pipeline with intake routing, orchestration, source collectors, and validators. Backed by unit and integration tests across routing, collection, and orchestration.
